_comment: Dataset locations for the PanoPin harness. Repoint here if data moves. GT = small JSONs (fast even on /mnt/d); room clouds are on fast ext4.

Area_3.notes: Room name in pano filename / pose JSON / camera_to_room.json is GT -> do NOT expose to solvers (see eval/make_manifest.py). Original S3DIS cloud <-> pano/pose frame = identity (~5mm), per Point_360. rooms_dir has 23 rooms; 21 have panos (hallway_5, storage_2 have none). pointcloud.mat is v7.3 HDF5 (slow on /mnt/d).
